1.consolidated_definition: Ave de hasta 10 cm de longitud, generalmente de color rojo bermellón, con cabeza y cola completamente negras y alas parcialmente negras. Fringillidae; Carduelis cucullata.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Bird of up to 10 cm in length, generally with a reddish-brown color, having a completely black head and tail, and partially black wings. Fringillidae; Carduelis cucullata.
